content.short: Cornell Blockchain educates Cornell University students about blockchain technology and its real-world applications.
content.description: Cornell Blockchain equips Cornell University students with a thorough understanding of blockchain technology and its real-world applications, preparing them to analyze, design, and engage with emerging blockchain use cases. The group also provides a collaborative platform where students can team up to brainstorm, develop, and showcase blockchain-related projects and applications. In addition, Cornell Blockchain offers in-depth educational resources that help students deepen their mastery of blockchain concepts and pursue blockchain-oriented career opportunities within the broader ecosystem.
